### Form I-9 Section 1

| Blank | Entry | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| B01 Last name | SURNAME_P1 | |
| B02 First name | GIVEN_P1 | |
| B03 Middle initial | MIDDLE_P1 | After restoration, enter only the first letter of your middle name. |
| B04 Other last names used | Leave blank | You’ve never used another last name. |
| B05 Street number and name | NEEDS-YOU | Enter your new U.S. home street address. |
| B06 Apartment number | NEEDS-YOU | Enter your apartment number if you have one. Otherwise, leave blank. |
| B07 City or town | NEEDS-YOU | Enter the city or town where you live. |
| B08 State | NEEDS-YOU | Enter the state where you live. |
| B09 ZIP code | NEEDS-YOU | Enter your home ZIP code. |
| B10 Date of birth | DATE_P1 | After restoration, write the date in `mm/dd/yyyy` format. Use two digits each for the month and day and four for the year. |
| B11 U.S. Social Security number | NEEDS-YOU | You haven’t received an SSN yet. Check the employer-provided instructions for how to handle the empty boxes while it’s pending. |
| B12 Email address | NEEDS-YOU | Enter your email address directly on the form. |
| B13 Telephone number | PHONE_P1 | |
| B14 Citizenship or immigration status | Check box 4 | Enter `01/15/2029` as the work authorization expiration date. |
| B15 Foreign passport number | ID_P1 | Use the foreign passport option. |
| B15 Country of issuance | India | |
| B16 Employee signature | NEEDS-YOU | Sign the form yourself. |
| B17 Today’s date | NEEDS-YOU | Enter the date you sign in `mm/dd/yyyy` format. |
